verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Pulumi has a public Registry of providers that every supported language can fully use, plus 300+ providers and standard language package management. That covers the consume side for providers only. Nothing in the pack shows reusable component modules in the registry or a way for developers to publish their own components to it. Missing for 10: evidence of consuming reusable components (not just providers) from the registry, a documented workflow for publishing components or packages to a public registry, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
